summary: Preserve durable person asks in replacement context and explicitly block unsupported native prompt refresh

replay.detail: Existing ask and answer claims retain their original identities.

rules.detail: Managed OMP refresh receipts report unsupported-native-prompt-preservation while an ask or permission is pending. Native prompts remain busy; stored approvals are not replayed.

compatibility.detail: Replacement boot context exposes outstanding durable person asks through the existing work surface. Native prompt capture and exact-call rebind remain unsupported.

recovery.detail: Durable asks remain answerable across intake seals and restart without cancellation or reposting. Automatic refresh remains disabled.
